# Northstar Bank

> Northstar is a demonstration digital bank with a Gemini-powered banking assistant. All accounts, balances, payments and cards are simulated mock data; no real money moves and no real bank, UPI network or card scheme is connected.

Everything beyond the sign-in page requires an authenticated session. Automated agents must not attempt to sign in, move money, or perform account actions: every payment, bill payment and card change needs explicit approval by the signed-in person through a confirmation button in the app.

## Public pages

- [Sign in](/): Entry point of the web app and the only page available without an account.

## Machine-readable status

- [Service health](/api/health): Public JSON health check for the demo API.
- [Assistant mode](/api/meta): Public JSON describing whether the assistant runs on Gemini or in offline demo mode, and confirming that all data is simulated.
